lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like matrix posterior to the branchial region, with the most distinct clusters appearing in the mid-flank rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal rows to form a coordinate-like system, where high-intensity blobs act as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and lower intensity shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized primarily within the lower two-thirds and posterior margin of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, dark, elongated silhouettes (consistent with commensal remoras) clustered ventrally to the pectoral fin and along the lower abdominal flank.
